snippet.title: 10+ Minutes of Raw Arena Gameplay | C4 (2025) | 2K 1440p
snippet.description:
Play the multiplayer demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3339490/C4_Classical_Caliber_Combat_Contest/

10+ minutes of raw, unedited Arena gameplay from C4: Classical Caliber Combat Contest, the "Arena Shooter Party Game" where classic action meets Item Boxes, Stage Hazards, Minigame rounds, loads of Weapons, Modes and Modifiers, and the unique card-based roguelike Contest party mode!

Developed by Secret Handshake Interactive.

More about the game:
--------------------
Classical Caliber Combat Contest is the "Arena Shooter Party Game" where classic action meets Item Boxes, Stage Hazards, Minigame rounds, loads of Weapons, Modes and Modifiers, and the unique card-based roguelike Contest party mode!

Cards build the Match! Complete Missions and place well to score Points, then cash them out for Gold in wild Minigames that happen during the action. When each round begins in the Lobby, spend your budget wisely to open card packs and level-up Cards. Build and play a strategic hand to attack and defend against other players, building the next match to the advantage of your selected Missions and play style. But don't get too comfortable, as some bonus Gold at the awards ceremony might just swing the results.

Wield an enormous collection of weapons, including arena shooter favorites and totally new creations! Punchy feedback, striking visuals and unique sound effects make each weapon a distinct implement of mayhem. Will your favorite be the classic Rocket Launcher? Or do you prefer the overloaded power of the Shell Compactor?

The Announcer narrates the non-stop action in the Arena, with more than 80 multi-kill, shutdown and special event medals to call and award. Battling across diverse maps covered in dynamic stage hazards, a cast of distinct computer-controlled characters fight alongside human players. All with unique appearances, skill levels and text chats, invite the strongest bots to your Contest if you dare!

--------------------
Wishlist now to get notified of the DEMO: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3339490/C4_Classical_Caliber_Combat_Contest/
--------------------

Join the Secret Handshake Discord today, where our community interacts directly with developers.

Secret Handshake Interactive is brought to you by players like you.
Thank you.
